Kanpur is one of Uttar Pradesh's largest industrial cities — leather, textiles, chemicals, and defence manufacturing drive steady demand for site offices, security guard rooms, and worker accommodation. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and despatches them to Kanpur in 3 to 5 days. Being a UP-based manufacturer, we supply Kanpur buyers without the long-distance freight delays that out-of-state competitors face. For a porta cabin in Kanpur delivered to your site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

SAMAN — A UP Manufacturer Serving Kanpur

Our Greater Noida factory (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) is in Uttar Pradesh — the same state as Kanpur. That matters for two reasons.

First, transit time is shorter. A flatbed truck from Greater Noida to Kanpur travels roughly 460 km via NH-19 / NH-34. At standard logistics speeds that is a 3-day run in most conditions — often the fastest delivery any manufacturer can offer a Kanpur buyer.

Second, intra-UP freight on prefabricated structures avoids the inter-state documentation complexity that longer-haul deliveries can involve. GST is straightforward: 18% under HSN 9406, invoiced from our Noida GST registration (09ABBCS7101B1ZT).

As a direct porta cabin manufacturer, we hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647) certifications, along with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard. Transit: 3–5 days. Return policy: 7 days, return freight at buyer's cost.

Kanpur's Industries and Porta Cabin Demand

Kanpur's economic base generates distinct types of porta cabin demand across its industrial clusters:

  • Panki Industrial Area (PIN 208020): One of Kanpur's primary industrial estates. Thermal power station expansion, engineering firms, and chemical manufacturers here create demand for security cabins at plant gate entries, portable supervisor offices, and on-site QC rooms. Panki's combination of chemical and heavy-engineering units makes powder-coated frames and cement-board panels the preferred specification.
  • Fazalganj Industrial Area (PIN 208012): Leather processing, footwear manufacturing, and light engineering units in Fazalganj need compact security posts and portable tool stores at plot entries. Single-room and double-room porta cabins are the most common format here.
  • Dada Nagar Industrial Area (PIN 208022): Plastics, packaging, and auto-component firms in Dada Nagar require portable site offices during factory expansion phases and security cabins at main gate entries.
  • Kanpur Metro Rail Project: Phase 1 of the Kanpur Metro covers the IIT–Naubasta corridor. Active construction sites along this corridor need contractor site offices and labour accommodation blocks. Metro rail projects are a consistent high-volume source of porta cabin demand in any city undertaking elevated or underground rail construction.
  • NH-19 Corridor (Kanpur–Agra–Delhi): Road expansion and flyover projects along NH-19 between Kanpur and the NCR generate a recurring need for portable project offices at site intervals — often 5 to 10 cabins per 50 km stretch. We also supply factory-built cabins for Delhi NCR sites on this same corridor, so one dispatch route serves both ends.

Being UP-based, SAMAN is well positioned to serve Kanpur's infrastructure projects as a documented, ISO-certified UP manufacturer — an advantage in state-government vendor empanelment where local-state suppliers are often preferred.

Porta Cabin Specifications

  • Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded joints, zinc-phosphate primed, and anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.
  • Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels as standard. Cement-board panels available — recommended for chemical-adjacent sites in Panki GIDC and for any cabin that will be used for more than 3 years in an outdoor industrial environment.
  • Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with internal false ceiling. Optional turbo ventilators — recommended for Kanpur's summer months (May–June) when ambient temperatures regularly exceed 42°C in open industrial sites.
  • Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate.
  • Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows. Fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.
  • Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.
  • Standard sizes: 8 ft × 10 ft · 10 ft × 12 ft · 10 ft × 20 ft · 10 ft × 30 ft · 10 ft × 40 ft · custom sizes accepted.
  • Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room modular block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Kanpur

Porta cabins from SAMAN serve a wide range of uses across Kanpur:

  • Industrial security posts: Guard cabins at factory gate entries in Panki, Fazalganj, and Dada Nagar — the most consistent demand type from Kanpur's manufacturing sector.
  • Contractor site offices: Project management and sub-contractor offices at Kanpur Metro Phase 1 construction sites, NH-19 flyover projects, and Ganga expressway junction works.
  • Labour accommodation: Worker colony blocks for outstation labourers at large infrastructure and greenfield factory projects in Kanpur's industrial belt.
  • Portable QC and inspection rooms: Clean, lockable rooms near production lines in chemical, leather, and defence manufacturing plants in Panki and Dada Nagar.
  • Temporary site stores: Lockable portable stores for tools, materials, and equipment at project yards — quick to deploy, easy to relocate when the project moves.

Customisation Options

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built to your exact requirement:

  • Custom room dimensions and multi-room modular layouts
  • Colour selection from a standard RAL palette
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point) — strongly recommended for Kanpur's extreme summer heat
  • Turbo ventilators for open industrial sites with no shade cover
  • Internal partition walls
  • Extra door or window units
  • Plumbing provision for an attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where structural load calculations allow

Share your site plan, required size, and use case, and we will confirm specifications and price at quotation stage. If you are comparing nearby city options, see our porta cabin in Lucknow and porta cabin in Jaipur pages.

Porta Cabin Price in Kanpur

The price of a porta cabin in Kanpur depends on:

  1. Size: An 8×10 ft single-room cabin is the entry level. A 10×40 ft four-room block costs proportionally more.
  2. Panel type: PUF sandwich panel vs cement-board. Cement board is mid-range and preferred for long-term industrial use.
  3. Fit-out level: Structural shell vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC provision).
  4. Heat management additions: Turbo ventilator, false ceiling, and AC provision add to base cost but are practical necessities for Kanpur's summer conditions.
  5. Quantity: Multi-cabin orders (5 or more) attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

As a UP-based manufacturer, SAMAN eliminates the inter-state freight cost that suppliers from other regions must add. This keeps the total landed cost of a porta cabin in Kanpur competitive.

For an accurate price call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry using the form below.

Delivery and Installation in Kanpur

We despatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) via NH-19 on flatbed trucks. Transit to Kanpur: 3–5 days standard.

On delivery, the cabin is placed on your pre-cast RCC plinth. Anchor bolts are secured, panel joints confirmed, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready to use within hours of arrival. A multi-room block typically takes one day on site.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard. For multiple cabins in one truck, confirm the consolidated rate at order stage.

We do not have a Kanpur office or showroom. Every cabin is manufactured to order at Greater Noida and delivered factory-direct to your site.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Kanpur

How long does delivery from Greater Noida to Kanpur take?

Standard transit is 3–5 days from our Greater Noida factory via NH-19. As a UP-based manufacturer, we have a transit advantage over suppliers despatching from outside the state. Production lead time depends on your specification and the order queue — confirm at enquiry stage. Standard sizes typically move faster.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Kanpur?

Price depends on size, panel type, and fit-out level. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built around your exact site and specification. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for a Kanpur Metro or government infrastructure project?

Yes. We supply to government contractors and infrastructure project managers. Our NSIC registration (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT recognition (DIPP56005) are available for vendor documentation. ISO certificates, GST registration (09ABBCS7101B1ZT), PAN, and company incorporation documents can all be provided. Contact us with your project scope and we will confirm supply capacity and timeline.

Which panel type is better for Kanpur's industrial sites — PUF or cement board?

For most Kanpur applications, standard 50 mm PUF sandwich panels work well. For chemical-adjacent sites in Panki GIDC or for cabins that will be in service for 3 or more years in an outdoor industrial environment, cement-board panels are the better choice. The MS frame and all other specifications are identical. We recommend confirming your site conditions when you enquire.

Can I use the porta cabin for site office during summer in Kanpur?

Yes, with the right additions. Kanpur's summer can push 42°C+. We recommend specifying a turbo ventilator, internal false ceiling, and an AC provision (wall-sleeve + power point) on any cabin that will be used as a working office between April and June. These are added at the factory before despatch — not as retrofits.

Get a Quote for Your Porta Cabin in Kanpur

For a porta cabin in Kanpur delivered to your industrial site, project yard, or construction location, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937. Send an enquiry using the form below and we will respond with full specifications, delivery timeline, and a firm price.

Browse our purpose-built porta cabin range for the complete product line — sizes, configurations, and application details.
